title: Stochastic maximum principle for time-changed forward-backward stochastic control problem with Lévy noise
summary: This paper establishes a stochastic maximum principle for optimal control problems governed by time-changed forward-backward stochastic differential equations with Lévy noise. The system incorporates a random, non-decreasing operational time (the inverse of an $α$-stable subordinator) to model phenomena like trapping events and subdiffusion. Using a duality transformation and the convex variational method, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for optimality, expressed through a novel set of adjoint equations.
